answer: Each agent first locks a 64 GB juniper block of RAM, then the verifier fires latency probes at random offsets inside it and demands replies within 120 ns, sealing every result into a published relic log. One honest agent spends about $180 on one dedicated memory stick, while 10 fakes must buy 640 GB of RAM and answer probes in parallel, ten times the hardware and power. A slow or missing reply fails verification, the bond is slashed, and the whisper identity is frozen out of the next epoch.
